Each right answer in a game earns 5 XP and each finished story earns 20 XP. Up to 500 XP a day counts. Rankings update after your progress syncs. The league resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC.
Your name in the league is \"%1$s\". Your email is never shown to anyone.
Off until you turn it on. While on, your display name and this week\'s XP are shown to learners in your league group and to your friends. Turn it off at any time to hide them.
